public_self_check_attempt.scope: Three known development cases, not a fresh blind evaluation; expressions replace model-computed numeric evidence; at most two repairs from public validation errors only.
public_self_check_attempt.transport_preflight_failure: An earlier sandboxed attempt could not connect to localhost; no generation. Preserved separately.
public_self_check_attempt.finding: Verbose nested JSON did not finish before the explicit deadline. No quality improvement demonstrated; incomplete answer rejected.

pin_skill_test.scope: Three synthetic controlled fixtures transcribed from an independently reviewed TI TXS0102 DCU pin table: correct mapping, swapped A1/A2, and missing applicable package reference. Not a fresh manufacturer-document extraction or production audit.
pin_skill_test.design: Matched public payloads and decoding; baseline already includes a precise task and response contract. Skill body injected explicitly in one arm only; alternating arm order; one sample per condition; separate private exact grading after all responses persisted.
pin_skill_test.decision: No measured skill lift on this small, simple set. Keep the recipe experimental; do not build a broad skill library or replace deterministic pin checks on this evidence.

partial_parent_usage_proxy.scope: Root-task research, LM Studio integration, harness/skill preparation, review and test observation. Child inclusion unverified; excludes later documentation, publication and final response. Not isolated inference cost, billing or a team total. Do not add overlapping earlier snapshots.

reproducibility_limit: Prototype skill, runners, raw fixtures/oracles and replies remain in local work/. This compact record is not a portable public test package or a new qualification of the failed original blind-pilot bar.
